probes.question: True or false: Napoleon was unusually short compared with other men of his time.
The British cartoonist James ____ helped popularise the image of a tiny Napoleon.

image.alt: Napoleon at the Great St. Bernard - Jacques-Louis David - Google Cultural Institute.jpg

body.claim: Napoleon was about 1.68 m (5 ft 6 in) tall, about average for a man of his time.
body.why: His height was recorded as 5 ft 2 in in pre-metric French measures, which works out to about 1.67 m. British cartoonists such as James Gillray drew him as tiny, and the image stuck.
